author: Netuddgi

title: By far the best habit building app available
body:
I’ve spent a lot of time researching other apps and this is the best. Hands down. 

The app is so simple to use and so powerful while being full of high quality learning resources to help you understand more about habit building to get the most out of both the app and yourself. 

The premium version is a must have and totally worth every penny.
author: MakingJamie

title: Daylight robbery
body: It’s a slick, nice, but extremely simple app with really minimal features. Selling this as a subscription is outrageous, let alone selling it for these prices...

title: 3 habits at free version and can’t delete account
body: There are only 3 habits that you can track for free, if you want more you need to upgrade. After I discovered it and wanted to delete my registration, you have no option for it and not even a FAQ to help with it....
